versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο, ἔχοντες τὴν διακονίαν ταύτην, καθὼς ἠλεήθημεν, οὐκ ἐγκακοῦμεν,

controles.web: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.
controles.kjv: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, as we have received mercy, we faint not;
controles.livre: Por isso, tendo este ministério, segundo a misericórdia que nos foi feita, não desfalecemos.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἀπειπάμεθα τὰ κρυπτὰ τῆς αἰσχύνης, μὴ περιπατοῦντες ἐν πανουργίᾳ μηδὲ δολοῦντες τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ, ἀλλὰ τῇ φανερώσει τῆς ἀληθείας συνιστάνοντες ἑαυτοὺς πρὸς πᾶσαν συνείδησιν ἀνθρώπων ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
controles.kjv: But have renounced the hidden things of dishonesty, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.
controles.livre: Mas já rejeitamos as coisas ocultas e vergonhosas, não andando com astúcia, nem falsificando a Palavra de Deus, mas pela manifestação da verdade fazemos recomendação de nós mesmos à consciência de todos os seres humanos, à vista de Deus.

versos.grego: εἰ δὲ καὶ ἔστιν κεκαλυμμένον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἡμῶν, ἐν τοῖς ἀπολλυμένοις ἐστὶν κεκαλυμμένον,

controles.web: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who perish;
controles.kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:
controles.livre: Porém se o nosso Evangelho está encoberto, é para os que se perdem que está encoberto;

versos.grego: ἐν οἷς ὁ θεὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου ἐτύφλωσεν τὰ νοήματα τῶν ἀπίστων εἰς τὸ μὴ αὐγάσαι τὸν φωτισμὸν τοῦ εὐαγγελίου τῆς δόξης τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.
controles.kjv: In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not, lest the light of the glorious gospel of Christ, who is the image of God, should shine unto them.
controles.livre: Nos quais o deus destes tempos cegou os entendimentos, isto é ,os incrédulos, para que não lhes brilhe a luz do Evangelho da glória de Cristo, que é a imagem de Deus.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἑαυτοὺς κηρύσσομεν ἀλλὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν Κύριον, ἑαυτοὺς δὲ δούλους ὑμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦν.

controles.web: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake;
controles.kjv: For we preach not ourselves, but Christ Jesus the Lord; and ourselves your servants for Jesus’ sake.
controles.livre: Porque nós não pregamos a nós mesmos, mas sim a Cristo Jesus, o Senhor; e a nós mesmos como vossos servos, por causa de Jesus.

versos.grego: ὅτι ὁ Θεὸς ὁ εἰπών Ἐκ σκότους φῶς λάμψει, ὃς ἔλαμψεν ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν πρὸς φωτισμὸν τῆς γνώσεως τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν προσώπῳ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For God, who commanded the light to shine out of darkness, hath shined in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: Porque o Deus que disse que das trevas brilhasse a luz é o mesmo que brilhou em nossos corações, para a iluminação do conhecimento da glória de Deus no rosto de Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Ἔχομεν δὲ τὸν θησαυρὸν τοῦτον ἐν ὀστρακίνοις σκεύεσιν, ἵνα ἡ ὑπερβολὴ τῆς δυνάμεως ᾖ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ μὴ ἐξ ἡμῶν·

controles.web: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.
controles.kjv: But we have this treasure in earthen vessels, that the excellency of the power may be of God, and not of us.
controles.livre: Porém temos este tesouro em vasos de barro, para que a excelência do poder seja de Deus, e não de nós.

versos.grego: ἐν παντὶ θλιβόμενοι ἀλλ’ οὐ στενοχωρούμενοι, ἀπορούμενοι ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐξαπορούμενοι,

controles.web: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;
controles.kjv: We are troubled on every side, yet not distressed; we are perplexed, but not in despair;
controles.livre: Somos em tudo afligidos, mas não esmagados; perplexos, mas não desesperados;

versos.grego: διωκόμενοι ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐγκαταλειπόμενοι, καταβαλλόμενοι ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἀπολλύμενοι,

controles.web: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;
controles.kjv: Persecuted, but not forsaken; cast down, but not destroyed;
controles.livre: Perseguidos, mas não desamparados; abatidos, porém não destruídos.

versos.grego: πάντοτε τὴν νέκρωσιν τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματι περιφέροντες, ἵνα καὶ ἡ ζωὴ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ ἐν τῷ σώματι ἡμῶν φανερωθῇ·

controles.web: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.
controles.kjv: Always bearing about in the body the dying of the Lord Jesus, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our body.
controles.livre: Sempre por todas as partes trazendo a mortificação do Senhor Jesus no corpo, para que também a vida de Jesus se manifeste em nossos corpos.

versos.grego: ἀεὶ γὰρ ἡμεῖς οἱ ζῶντες εἰς θάνατον παραδιδόμεθα διὰ Ἰησοῦν, ἵνα καὶ ἡ ζωὴ τοῦ Ἰησοῦ φανερωθῇ ἐν τῇ θνητῇ σαρκὶ ἡμῶν.

controles.web: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.
controles.kjv: For we which live are alway delivered unto death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus might be made manifest in our mortal flesh.
controles.livre: Porque nós, que vivemos, estamos sempre entregues à morte por causa de Jesus, para que também a vida de Jesus se manifeste em nossa carne mortal.

versos.grego: ὥστε ὁ θάνατος ἐν ἡμῖν ἐνεργεῖται, ἡ δὲ ζωὴ ἐν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: So then death works in us, but life in you.
controles.kjv: So then death worketh in us, but life in you.
controles.livre: De maneira que a morte opera em nós, mas em vós opera a vida.

versos.grego: ἔχοντες δὲ τὸ αὐτὸ πνεῦμα τῆς πίστεως, κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον Ἐπίστευσα, διὸ ἐλάλησα, καὶ ἡμεῖς πιστεύομεν, διὸ καὶ λαλοῦμεν,

controles.web: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore also we speak;
controles.kjv: We having the same spirit of faith, according as it is written, I believed, and therefore have I spoken; we also believe, and therefore speak;
controles.livre: E nós temos o mesmo Espírito de fé, assim como está escrito: Cri, e por isso falei;Nós também cremos, e por isso também falamos,

versos.grego: εἰδότες ὅτι ὁ ἐγείρας τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ ἡμᾶς σὺν Ἰησοῦ ἐγερεῖ καὶ παραστήσει σὺν ὑμῖν.

controles.web: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.
controles.kjv: Knowing that he which raised up the Lord Jesus shall raise up us also by Jesus, and shall present us with you.
controles.livre: sabendo que o que ressuscitou ao Senhor Jesus, também nos ressuscitará por meio de Jesus, e nos apresentará juntos de vós.

versos.grego: τὰ γὰρ πάντα δι’ ὑμᾶς, ἵνα ἡ χάρις πλεονάσασα διὰ τῶν πλειόνων τὴν εὐχαριστίαν περισσεύσῃ εἰς τὴν δόξαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.
controles.kjv: For all things are for your sakes, that the abundant grace might through the thanksgiving of many redound to the glory of God.
controles.livre: Porque todas estas coisas são por causa de vós, para que a graça aumente por meio de muitas pessoas ,superabundando os agradecimentos à glória de Deus.

versos.grego: Διὸ οὐκ ἐγκακοῦμεν, ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ ὁ ἔξω ἡμῶν ἄνθρωπος διαφθείρεται, ἀλλ’ ὁ ἔσω ἡμῶν ἀνακαινοῦται ἡμέρᾳ καὶ ἡμέρᾳ.

controles.web: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.
controles.kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
controles.livre: Por isso não desfalecemos; mas ainda que nosso ser exterior se destrua, todavia o interior se renova a cada dia.

versos.grego: τὸ γὰρ παραυτίκα ἐλαφρὸν τῆς θλίψεως καθ’ ὑπερβολὴν εἰς ὑπερβολὴν αἰώνιον βάρος δόξης κατεργάζεται ἡμῖν,

controles.web: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;
controles.kjv: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
controles.livre: Porque nossa leve e momentânea aflição nos produz um peso eterno de excelentíssima glória.

versos.grego: μὴ σκοπούντων ἡμῶν τὰ βλεπόμενα ἀλλὰ τὰ μὴ βλεπόμενα· τὰ γὰρ βλεπόμενα πρόσκαιρα, τὰ δὲ μὴ βλεπόμενα αἰώνια.

controles.web: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.
controles.kjv: While we look not at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are temporal; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
controles.livre: Por isso nós não prestamos atenção para as coisas visíveis, mas sim para as invisíveis; porque as coisas visíveis são temporárias, mas as invisíveis são eternas.
